responsibility: Implements the old trait-selection engine’s core selection and evaluation machinery, owning the selection context, caches and recursion tracking needed to evaluate trait obligations, report ambiguity causes, and coordinate candidate assembly, confirmation, and projection interaction.
same_name_distinction: Among the `traits/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the old trait solver’s selection engine. It defines `SelectionContext`, obligation-stack recursion tracking, provisional evaluation caching, ambiguity tracking, and candidate evaluation/confirmation boundaries, which distinguishes it from the root `traits/mod.rs` facade and from query, specialization, or diagnostics modules.
